content: व्यावृत् €1 <ab>Ā.</ab> ²1 To turn away from, turn back; सहभुवा व्यावर्तमाना ह्रिया <ls>Ratn. 1. 2</ls>. .²2 To be turned or withdrawn from, to be averse to; विषयव्यावृत्तकौतूहलः <ls>V. 1. 8</ls>. .²3 To become separate or distinct from, to get rid of; न स पाम्मनो व्यावर्तते <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 5. 2</ls>. .²4 To turn round, revolve. .²5 To go down, set (as the sun). .²6 To cease to exist, perish. .²7 To be opened or split asunder. .²8 To recur, to be repeated again; देशपृथक्त्वात् मन्त्रो व्यावर्तते <ls>Ms. 12. 1. 42</ls>. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} .²1 To restrict, limit, exclude, arrest; overrule, annul (as a rule <ab>&c.</ab>); तु शब्दः पूर्वपक्षं व्यावर्तयति <ls>Ś. B.</ls>; अपवाद इवोत्सर्गं व्यावर्तयितुमीश्वरः <ls>R. 15. 7</ls>. .²2 To dissuade from, cause to turn away from; नेयमस्माद्व्यवसायात् कथंचिदपि शक्यते व्यावर्तयितुम् <ls>K. 172</ls>. .²3 To destroy, remove; व्यावर्तितातपरुजः प्रथमाभ्रवृष्टपा <ls>V. 5. 16</ls>. .²4 To turn round, cause to revolve. .²5 To separate from. .²6 To scatter, strew.
